title: Connected skill package declaration
description: Seam 4 of docs/integration-contract.md. A repository that extends prometheus-skill-pack declares itself with a skill-package.json at its root. The pack validates the declaration with `prometheus contract validate`; it never installs the extension. The extension's own installer places its skills and registers its MCP servers and hook bundles with each harness.

name.description: Package identity, kebab-case. Namespaces the extension's hook bundles and skills so they cannot collide with the pack's.

minimumContractVersion.description: Minimum integration-contract version this extension requires. Validation fails when it exceeds the version the pack implements, naming both.

skills.description: Directory of skills the extension installs, relative to its repository root, in agentskills.io layout.

items.description: Namespaced bundle name, '<package>/<bundle>', resolved through run-hook --bundle. A bare name is refused because it could collide with a pack bundle.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers the extension registers with harnesses. The extension's installer writes and owns these entries; the pack never writes them.

services.description: Services the extension installs and supervises itself. The pack's own services are described by shared/services.manifest.json (seam 3) and are not listed here.
